channel.title: The Box Plus Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Box Plus Network (boxplus.com)

item.title: Speaker Lindsay Hoyle says he warned police Mandelson could be flight risk
item.description: The Metropolitan Police has apologised to the Speaker of the House of Commons, Sir Lindsay Hoyle for revealing information relating to Lord Mandelson's arrest on Monday.

item.title: Chagos Islands deal on pause after Trump criticism of UK government
item.description: Britain won't proceed with its deal with Mauritius to lease back the Chagos Islands, home to the Diego Garcia military base, unless the United States approves.

item.title: UK energy bills to fall from April
item.description: Energy prices will fall for millions of people in April, with annual household bills being cut by £117 - reducing electricity and gas payments by around £10 per month for the average household.

item.title: UK energy bills ‘going in right direction’, says energy minister
item.description: We spoke to the minister responsible for energy consumers, Martin McCluskey.

item.title: 72 hours of Epstein: Mandelson and Royals caught in his web
item.description: It's clear from the deluge of emails in the Epstein files that from politicians to princes, Jeffrey Epstein held extraordinary influence over those in positions of power in Britain.

item.title: Environmental groups pile pressure on government over sewage spills
item.description: It is common and controversial knowledge that water companies pump raw untreated sewage into our streams, rivers, lakes and our beaches. But a Channel 4 docu-drama Dirty Business, concluding tonight, confronts the sheer scale and illegality of the pollution.

item.title: Dirty Business: mother of girl killed by E. coli infection demands water reform
item.description: We were joined from Worcestershire by Julie Maughan, whose daughter's story formed the inspiration for some of Dirty Business.

item.title: Scottish government orders public inquiry into grooming gangs
item.description: The Scottish government has ordered public inquiry into grooming gangs that will focus on both historic and current child sexual abuse and exploitation.

item.title: Grenfell families bring legal challenge to pause tower demolition
item.description: Some of the families who lost loved ones in the Grenfell Tower fire in 2017 have brought a legal challenge to the government to pause the demolition of the building.

item.title: Trump’s record-breaking State of the Union address – FactChecked
item.description: “Bigger, better, richer and stronger than ever before” - just some of the words Donald Trump used to describe the US under his presidency in an almost two-hour State of the Union address.
